query: SELECT season, MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM Match GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

query: SELECT date FROM Player_Attributes LIMIT 3; SELECT MIN(date), MAX(date), COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM Player_Attributes; same for Team_Attributes

query: SELECT date, COUNT(*) FROM Team_Attributes GROUP BY date ORDER BY date; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) FROM Team_Attributes

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id, date FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>1); SELECT SUM(overall_rating IS NULL), SUM(volleys IS NULL) FROM Player_Attributes

query: SELECT attacking_work_rate, COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY 1; SELECT defensive_work_rate, COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY 1
result: attacking_work_rate valid levels: medium 125070, high 42823, low 8569; beyond them the literal None 3639, empty 3230, norm 348, y 106, le 104 and stoc 89. defensive_work_rate valid levels: medium 130846, high 27041, low 18432; beyond them _0 2394, o 1550, empty 836 and fragments such as ormal, es, ean and tocky along with digit strings 0 to 9.

query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN attacking_work_rate IN ('low','medium','high') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN defensive_work_rate IN ('low','medium','high') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Player_Attributes
result: Of 183978 rows, 176462 carry a valid attacking work rate and 176319 carry a valid defensive work rate; the remainder are corrupted or empty.

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id), COUNT(DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id), SUM(team_fifa_api_id IS NULL) FROM Team; duplicate check on team_fifa_api_id; referential checks from Match and Team_Attributes
result: 299 team rows, 299 distinct team_api_id, 285 distinct team_fifa_api_id and 11 null fifa ids. query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_long_name), COUNT(DISTINCT team_short_name) FROM Team; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
result: Team has 296 distinct long names and 259 distinct short names over 299 rows, with short names such as BEL occurring three times. 18 players have a name beginning with Aaron, for example Aaron Mooy born 1990-09-15 and Aaron Ramsey born 1990-12-26.

query: schema inspection of Player and Match; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 IS NULL
result: Player has no team column and there is no squad table; the only link is the home_player_1..11 and away_player_1..11 slots on Match, which hold player_api_id values. 1224 of 25979 matches have a null home_player_1 and 1554 have a null away_player_11.
